description: Read-only view of a single content block within a page. Returned by INotionBlockProvider. The concrete type is PageBlock from Tempo.Blazor.NotionEditor.Models, which you can use directly or subclass.

properties.name: PageId
properties.description: ID of the page that owns this block.

properties.name: ParentBlockId
properties.description: ID of the parent block for nested blocks (toggle children, column children). Null for top-level blocks.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Block type enum (Paragraph, Heading1–3, BulletList, NumberedList, TodoItem, Toggle, Quote, Callout, Code, Image, Video, Audio, Pdf, File, Bookmark, Embed, Equation, ColumnList, Column, Database, Diagram, Wireframe, Spreadsheet, SyncedBlock, Divider, TableOfContents).

properties.name: Order
properties.description: Zero-based display order within the parent (page or container block).

properties.name: Content
properties.description: Typed content payload. Cast to the concrete content type matching the block's Type (e.g. TextBlockContent, ImageBlockContent, CodeBlockContent).
